form_data.address: House No. 14, Harmu Housing Colony, Ranchi - 834002
form_data.facts_narrative: The applicant was falsely implicated in FIR No. 78/2026 arising out of a property dispute between the complainant and the applicant's family. The applicant was not present at the spot at the time of the alleged incident and has CCTV evidence from a nearby shop establishing his presence elsewhere. He was arrested on 02.04.2026 and has been in judicial custody since then.
